evaluation_items.title: Cross-workload non-monotonicity
evaluation_items.visual_question: Can adding statistics worsen target-workload CE loss?
evaluation_items.encoding: Two independent workload panels; use workload-local axes and never connect panels. Raw values remain labeled.
evaluation_items.caption: Statistics-set inclusion is empirically non-monotone in both frozen realizations. Panels use separate axes because DMV's floor-based objective is dominated by two zero-truth queries; absolute loss is not compared across workloads.

evaluation_items.title: Mechanism-aware recurring ANALYZE cost
evaluation_items.visual_question: Does aggregate ANALYZE latency admit a useful first-order mechanism-aware approximation?
evaluation_items.encoding: Separate Census and DMV panels sourced directly from their CSVs; distinct MCV/FD fits and no shared regression line.
evaluation_items.caption: Aggregate ANALYZE latency is approximately first-order in deployed mechanism counts in each measured environment, but the fitted coefficients differ. The model is a resource proxy rather than a universal or candidate-specific PostgreSQL cost function.

evaluation_items.title: Native semantic fidelity within the supported fragment
evaluation_items.takeaway: Controlled, real-workload, and fresh-deployment comparisons all match native PostgreSQL at floating-point-scale relative error inside the supported boundary.

evaluation_items.title: Directed MCV-to-FD composition
evaluation_items.visual_question: Does MCV clause consumption suppress FD use, and can joint selection restore it?
evaluation_items.encoding: Top: MCV-to-residual-clause-state-to-FD diagram. Bottom: compact Census and DMV all/independent versus joint/selected consumption comparison.
evaluation_items.caption: MCV executes first and changes the clause state visible to FD. Independent/all-statistics states can suppress FD contribution, whereas composition-aware subsets restore FD reachability in both workloads and after DMV deployment.

evaluation_items.title: Physical deployment and fresh native validation
evaluation_items.takeaway: Both selected states were physically realized and match fresh native CE; only Census supports a complete paired numerical drift analysis.
